## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependency, or configuration updates

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code follows formatting and lint rules: `.venv\Scripts\ruff check .` passes
- [ ] Code follows formatting: `.venv\Scripts\ruff format --check .` passes
- [ ] Automated tests pass: `.venv\Scripts\pytest`
- [ ] Coverage gate satisfied: line & branch coverage >= 86% (`check_coverage.py`)
- [ ] Any architectural decision recorded in `.sdlc/docs/decisions.log`
- [ ] Documentation updated in `docs/` or `.sdlc/` if applicable
